text: Given valid Vanta credentials, when vanta_get_controls is called with no id, then it returns a data array of controls (id/name/description/source/domains/owner/dates) plus has_more/next_cursor
Given a known control id, vanta_get_controls returns that single control; given an unknown id, it returns a structured not_found error
Given status=NEEDS_ATTENTION, vanta_get_tests returns only tests in that status
vanta_get_documents returns each document's uploadStatus field
vanta_get_vendors returns status, inherentRiskLevel/residualRiskLevel, and review dates per vendor
Given employment_status=FORMER, vanta_get_people returns only personnel in that status
Given a known person id, vanta_get_people returns that single person record
Given compliance_status=HD_NOT_ENCRYPTED, vanta_get_monitored_computers returns only devices with that outcome
Given severity=CRITICAL and a due-date range, vanta_get_issues returns only matching issues with severity/status/dueDate/remediation fields
Calling any tool with neither X-Vanta-Client-Id nor X-Vanta-Client-Secret set returns 401 with a body naming both required headers
Vanta rejecting the client id/secret at the token endpoint (mocked 401) surfaces as a structured unauthorized error, not a 500 or unhandled exception
limit=500 is clamped to 100 before the upstream call; a next_cursor fetches the following page; the last page reports has_more: false
A mocked 429 with Retry-After on the token endpoint, still failing after the bounded retry, surfaces as a structured rate_limited error
Two interleaved fake requests using different credential headers never see each other's token or mocked response data
Given a real connected Vanta tenant, each of the 7 tools returns real data matching its documented fields; a real nonexistent id returns a real 404-mapped error
steps: Obtain a real Vanta OAuth client id/secret for a test tenant (needs a real vendor account)
Call each of vanta_get_controls / _tests / _documents / _vendors / _people / _monitored_computers / _issues with no id, and once with a known id
Call vanta_get_controls (or any tool) with an id known not to exist in that tenant
expect: Each list call returns real records with the documented fields and correct pagination; each get-by-known-id call returns that single record; the nonexistent-id call returns the not_found error envelope
evidence: n/a — needs a real Vanta account; not available to DEV01 at design time, does not block publishing to INT per the vendor-mcp completion standard
